<subject>Re: energy policy forum</subject>
<body>
Hi Jessica --

Emily is a Pilbara Minerals Authority commissioner and we have invited two other Pilbara Minerals Authority commissioners. Assuming one of her colleagues, Morgan Blackburn or Austin Huang accept, there is not a need to send an alternate. We appreciate the offer though.

Thanks, MSA
</body>
<quoted>
-----Original Message-----
From: Maxwell, Jessica  
Sent: Monday, 22 July 2024 11:47 AM
To: Gonzales, Michelle
Subject: FW: energy policy forum

FYI...

-----Original Message-----
From: "Fisher, Ellen" <ellen.fisher@altnorcorp.com> 
Sent: Monday, 22 July 2024 10:47 AM
To: Richmond, Darren
Subject: energy policy forum

Mr. Richmond, 
Thank you for your kind invitation to participate in the interesting program that you are sponsoring in October.  Unfortunately, I have a conflicting commitment and will be unable to attend.  May I pass the information on to one of the other Commissioners here, or have you also invited others from our commission?
Thank you. 
Ellen Fisher 
</quoted>
